parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date that is accurate to the day part for the query. The date must be in the yyyy-MM-dd format.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: quotaNicknameList
parameters.description: The list of nicknames of quotas that are used by jobs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun maxcompute get-job-resource-usage --date 2023-05-15 --job-owner-list ALIYUN_xxx@test.aliyunid.com --quota-nickname-list my_quota --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
